senses.gloss: (cmp. חתת) to shrink from, to loathe.—Part. חָת, f. חָתָה, חוֹתָה (cmp. חָלָה a. חוֹלָה fr. חוּל).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 8:2:2">Y. Ter. VIII, 45ᶜ</cite> top (ref. to <he>שקץ</he>) <he>כל דבר שנפשו … חָתָה ממנו</he> anything loathsome.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 11:1">Pesik. R. s. 11</cite> <he>ונפשו של אדם חתה מהם וכ׳</he> and one shrinks from eating them.

<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 2:10">Esth. R. to I, 7</cite> <he>והלא נפשו של אדם ח׳ וכ׳</he> does not man rather loathe to drink out of golden cups? [<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 4:3:3">Y. Yoma IV, 41ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>לחות</he>, read <he>לחתות</he>, v. <he>חָתָה</he> I.]

senses.gloss: to create aversion. Y. Shebi. IV, 35ᵇ bot.; Y. Maasr. I, 48ᵈ, v. בָּחַל.
